notes: REF-BM-02: extracts title/description/favicon but never preview image (no og:image; no preview column). REF-BM-08: clicking a list item goes to the internal detail page, not the original url; the external link only appears one click deeper on the detail view. REF-BM-10: tags input is a plain comma text field with no autocomplete/datalist of existing tags. REF-BM-11: single-tag filtering is only achievable by typing a search query; tags render as non-interactive spans with no click-to-filter or tag route. REF-BM-14: tag search uses `tag:`/`tag:"..."` syntax, not the specified `#tag`; typing `#book` is treated as a literal term. REF-BM-20: bulk supports add-tags/read/unread/archive/delete but has no remove-tags action. REF-BM-23: markdown notes are stored but rendered as plain text (no markdown library/rendering). REF-BM-24: no snapshot feature; non-HTML/PDF content is rejected during metadata fetch. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-29: no bundle entity, table, or UI. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export. REF-BM-32: no user settings (default sort/displayed items/font size); sort is only a per-request query param.
